headline: Montra Electric logs 3.6 crore km across electric trucks, saving Rs 70 crore
hook: 7 crore rupees saved by electric trucks

modes.bear: High upfront costs and charging infrastructure gaps could slow down wider commercial EV adoption despite mileage milestones.
modes.bull: Commercial EV mileage milestones prove durability, accelerating fleet electrification and boosting long-term demand for domestic EV makers.
modes.simple: Electric trucks in India have driven a huge distance and saved money, showing that electric commercial transport is slowly becoming practical.

summary: Montra Electric's electric commercial vehicles have collectively covered 3.6 crore kilometers on Indian roads. This milestone resulted in operational savings of approximately Rs 70 crore for fleet operators. The data reflects growing adoption and real-world durability of heavy electric commercial vehicles in logistics. For Indian retail investors, this demonstrates accelerating EV adoption in the commercial freight segment.
why_it_matters: Commercial EV adoption gains real-world validation in logistics.
winners_losers: EV manufacturers gain / traditional diesel truck makers hurt

headline: Tube Investments reports 39% rise in Q2 consolidated profit
hook: Engineering segment drives TII quarterly growth
summary: Tube Investments of India (TII) reported a 39% increase in consolidated net profit for the second quarter. The company's engineering segment revenue rose to ₹1,828 crore, compared to ₹1,382 crore in the same period last year. While consolidated figures showed strong growth, standalone profit after tax remained flat. The results reflect the performance of the company's diversified engineering operations.
why_it_matters: Engineering segment strength offsets flat standalone performance for shareholders.
winners_losers: Engineering segment gains / Standalone business neutral
